attributes.template_name: nginx DNS Resolver Off-by-One Heap Write
attributes.description: nginx resolver is vulnerable to a 1-byte memory overwrite that can lead to worker process crash or potential remote code execution when resolving an attacker-controlled DNS response.

attributes.template_name: Spring Cloud Gateway Actuator API - SpEL Code Injection
attributes.description: Spring Cloud Gateway Actuator Gateway API endpoint accepts a malicious Spring Expression Language (SpEL) payload in a crafted route definition, leading to remote code execution.
An HTTP request parsing ambiguity in werkzeug allows request smuggling when chunked and content-length framing are both present.
Jenkins CLI command parser (args4j) allows an attacker to read arbitrary files on the controller filesystem via the @ character file-expansion feature.

attributes.template_name: Atlassian Confluence Server - Unauthenticated OGNL Injection RCE
attributes.description: Confluence Server and Data Center are vulnerable to unauthenticated remote code execution via OGNL expression injection.
